transcript.text: I need to share critical blood-bank information about this patient. The patient has documented antibodies against common platelet antigens. Because of this, the blood bank has a compatible HLA-selected, irradiated single-donor platelet unit specifically reserved for this patient. This specialized unit is reserved only until 22:00 tonight, and it must be picked up from the blood bank by 20:30 in order to preserve the planned 20:00 transfusion start time that Dr. Chen has outlined. Given the patient's antibody status, a standard pooled platelet product would not be appropriate — the HLA-selected unit is the product we need to release.
